mapper.select: SELECT MBER_ID FROM TB_MBER WHERE MBER_ID = #{mberId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FCLTY_SN, ACMD_NMPR, OPER_BEGIN_TM, OPER_END_TM, RESVE_UNIT_MIN FROM TB_FCLTY WHERE FCLTY_SN = #{fcltySn} AND USE_YN = 'Y' FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_RESVE WHERE FCLTY_SN = #{fcltySn} AND RESVE_DE = #{resveDe} AND RESVE_STTUS_CD IN ('01', '02') AND #{beginTm} < END_TM AND #{endTm} > BEGIN_TM
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_FCLTY_CLOSE WHERE FCLTY_SN = #{fcltySn} AND CLOSE_DE = #{resveDe}
mapper.insert: SELECT SEQ_RESVE.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL INSERT INTO TB_RESVE (RESVE_SN, FCLTY_SN, MBER_ID, RESVE_DE, BEGIN_TM, END_TM, USE_NMPR, USE_PURPS, RESVE_STTUS_CD, REGIST_DT) VALUES (#{resveSn}, #{fcltySn}, #{mberId}, #{resveDe}, #{beginTm}, #{endTm}, #{useNmpr}, #{usePurps}, #{resveSttusCd}, SYSDATE)

INSERT INTO TB_RESVE_HIST (HIST_SN, RESVE_SN, BFR_STTUS_CD, AFT_STTUS_CD, CHANGE_RSN, CHANGER_ID, CHANGE_DT) VALUES (SEQ_RESVE_HIST.NEXTVAL, #{resveSn}, #{bfrSttusCd}, #{aftSttusCd}, #{changeRsn}, #{changerId}, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_RESVE SET RESVE_STTUS_CD = #{aftSttusCd}, RETURN_RSN = NVL(#{returnRsn}, RETURN_RSN), UPDUSR_ID = #{updusrId}, UPDT_DT = SYSDATE WHERE RESVE_SN = #{resveSn} AND RESVE_STTUS_CD = #{bfrSttusCd}
mapper.sql: R.RESVE_SN, R.FCLTY_SN, F.FCLTY_NM, R.MBER_ID, M.MBER_NM, R.RESVE_DE, R.BEGIN_TM, R.END_TM, R.USE_NMPR, R.USE_PURPS, R.RESVE_STTUS_CD, C.CODE_NM AS RESVE_STTUS_NM, R.RETURN_RSN, R.REGIST_DT, R.UPDUSR_ID, R.UPDT_DT
FROM TB_RESVE R JOIN TB_FCLTY F ON F.FCLTY_SN = R.FCLTY_SN JOIN TB_MBER M ON M.MBER_ID = R.MBER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CMMN_CODE C ON C.CODE_ID = 'RESVE_STTUS' AND C.CODE = R.RESVE_STTUS_CD
mapper.select: SELECT H.HIST_SN, H.RESVE_SN, H.BFR_STTUS_CD, B.CODE_NM AS BFR_STTUS_NM, H.AFT_STTUS_CD, A.CODE_NM AS AFT_STTUS_NM, H.CHANGE_RSN, H.CHANGER_ID, H.CHANGE_DT FROM TB_RESVE_HIST H LEFT JOIN TB_CMMN_CODE B ON B.CODE_ID = 'RESVE_STTUS' AND B.CODE = H.BFR_STTUS_CD LEFT JOIN TB_CMMN_CODE A ON A.CODE_ID = 'RESVE_STTUS' AND A.CODE = H.AFT_STTUS_CD WHERE H.RESVE_SN = #{resveSn} ORDER BY H.HIST_SN

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_RESVE WHERE RESVE_STTUS_CD = '01' AND RESVE_DE >= #{today}) AS PENDING_CNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_RESVE WHERE RESVE_STTUS_CD = '02' AND RESVE_DE = #{today}) AS TODAY_CNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_RESVE WHERE REGIST_DT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 6) AS WEEK_APPLY_CNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_RESVE_HIST WHERE AFT_STTUS_CD = '02' AND CHANGE_DT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM')) AS MONTH_APPROVE_CNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_RESVE_HIST WHERE AFT_STTUS_CD = '03' AND CHANGE_DT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM')) AS MONTH_RETURN_CNT FROM DUAL
